title: Integral mixed geometric composition from completion-unit cancellation
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E and F of Q_l and a Q_l-algebra embedding i : E → F. Let g : X → Y and h : Z → X be morphisms of noetherian finite-dimensional schemes with l invertible. Supply the rational realization pullback comparisons for g, h and h followed by g over both fields, as in lem-per-rational-realization-pullback-comparison. Let cE and cF be isomorphisms from the consecutive integral completed pullbacks to the composite integral completed pullback. Assume their underlying morphisms satisfy the canonical ordinary-pullback compositor equation with the two actual completion units. Then for every integral constructible complete object K on Y, scalar extension of cE(K), followed by strict beta for the composite, equals strict beta for h at the completed g-pullback of K, followed by completed h-pullback of strict beta for g at K, followed by cF at scalar extension of K. All the maps are the specified rationalScalarStrictBeta, pbcEmbeddingAmbientTensor and integral completedFunctor maps, not newly selected comparisons.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, pp. 61–62; the completion-unit and scalar associativity calculation in the parent node, step 6 or 7.

proof.text: Invert pbcScalarOrdinaryPull_comp. Naturality of ordinary beta at the g-completion unit and naturality of the h-completion unit at strict beta give the mixed squares needed to paste the two unit-square identities.

Precompose by scalar extension of h-pullback of the g-completion unit and then scalar extension of the h-completion unit. Use the assumed equations for cE and cF and cancel the invertible precompositions, whose invertibility is supplied by the pullback comparisons. This gives exactly the strict integral equation.

theorem rationalMixedIntegralGeometricComposition
    (cE : aE.integral.completedFunctor l E ⋙ ahE.integral.completedFunctor l E ≅
      acE.integral.completedFunctor l E)
    (cF : aF.integral.completedFunctor l F ⋙ ahF.integral.completedFunctor l F ≅
      acF.integral.completedFunctor l F)
    (uE : ∀ K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E),
      (pbcActualDerivedPull h (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).map
          ((pbcActualStrictCompletedPullUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g).app K.obj) ≫
        (pbcActualStrictCompletedPullUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l E) h).app
          ((aE.integral.completedFunctor l E).obj K).obj ≫ (cE.hom.app K).hom =
      (pbcActualDerivedPullCompIso h g (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).inv.app K.obj ≫
        (pbcActualStrictCompletedPullUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (h ≫ g)).app K.obj)
    (uF : ∀ K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcIntegralDatum l F),
      (pbcActualDerivedPull h (pbcIntegralDatum l F)).map
          ((pbcActualStrictCompletedPullUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l F) g).app K.obj) ≫
        (pbcActualStrictCompletedPullUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l F) h).app
          ((aF.integral.completedFunctor l F).obj K).obj ≫ (cF.hom.app K).hom =
      (pbcActualDerivedPullCompIso h g (pbcIntegralDatum l F)).inv.app K.obj ≫
        (pbcActualStrictCompletedPullUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l F) (h ≫ g)).app K.obj)
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    (pbcEmbeddingAmbientTensor l E F i Z).map (cE.hom.app K).hom ≫
        (rationalScalarStrictBeta l E F i (h ≫ g)).hom.app K.obj =
      (rationalScalarStrictBeta l E F i h).hom.app
          ((aE.integral.completedFunctor l E).obj K).obj ≫
        (pbcActualStrictCompletedPull (pbcIntegralDatum l F) h).map
          ((rationalScalarStrictBeta l E F i g).hom.app K.obj) ≫
        (cF.hom.app ((pbcEmbeddingIntegralTensor l E F i Y Fact.out Fact.out).obj K)).hom
